findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order · Private data: read_the_papers, leave_note, taste, open_tap, ask_the_room, buy_a_round · Public sink: order, buy_a_round.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order · Private data: read_the_papers, leave_note, taste, open_tap, ask_the_room, buy_a_round · Public sink: order, buy_a_round

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "order" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
